verses.original: ר֛וּחַ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה עָלָ֑י יַ֡עַן יְהוָ֨ה אֹתִ֜י מָשַׁח֩ לְבַשֵּׂ֣ר עֲנָוִ֗ים שְׁלָחַ֙נִי֙ לַחֲבֹ֣שׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־ לֵ֔ב לִקְרֹ֤א דְּר֔וֹר לִשְׁבוּיִם֙ פְּקַח־ קֽוֹחַ׃ וְלַאֲסוּרִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ‘ā·lāy ya·‘an Yah·weh ’ō·ṯî mā·šaḥ lə·ḇaś·śêr ‘ă·nā·wîm šə·lā·ḥa·nî la·ḥă·ḇōš lə·niš·bə·rê- lêḇ liq·rō də·rō·wr liš·ḇū·yim pə·qaḥ- qō·w·aḥ wə·la·’ă·sū·rîm
verses.literal: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me because the LORD - has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted . . . to proclaim liberty to the captives vvv and freedom to the prisoners

verses.original: לִקְרֹ֤א שְׁנַת־ לַֽיהוָ֔ה רָצוֹן֙ וְי֥וֹם לֵאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ נָקָ֖ם לְנַחֵ֖ם כָּל־ אֲבֵלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: liq·rō šə·naṯ- Yah·weh rā·ṣō·wn wə·yō·wm lê·lō·hê·nū nā·qām lə·na·ḥêm kāl- ’ă·ḇê·lîm
verses.literal: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of our God’s vengeance to comfort all who mourn

verses.original: לָשׂ֣וּם׀ לַאֲבֵלֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן לָתֵת֩ לָהֶ֨ם פְּאֵ֜ר תַּ֣חַת אֵ֗פֶר שֶׁ֤מֶן שָׂשׂוֹן֙ תַּ֣חַת אֵ֔בֶל מַעֲטֵ֣ה תְהִלָּ֔ה תַּ֖חַת ר֣וּחַ כֵּהָ֑ה וְקֹרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֵילֵ֣י הַצֶּ֔דֶק מַטַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לְהִתְפָּאֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lā·śūm la·’ă·ḇê·lê ṣî·yō·wn lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem pə·’êr ta·ḥaṯ ’ê·p̄er še·men śā·śō·wn ta·ḥaṯ ’ê·ḇel ma·‘ă·ṭêh ṯə·hil·lāh ta·ḥaṯ rū·aḥ kê·hāh wə·qō·rā lā·hem ’ê·lê haṣ·ṣe·ḏeq maṭ·ṭa‘ Yah·weh lə·hiṯ·pā·’êr
verses.literal: to console the mourners in Zion to give them a crown of beauty for ashes the oil of joy for mourning and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair So they will be called . . . oaks of righteousness the planting of the LORD that He may be glorified

verses.original: וּבָנוּ֙ עוֹלָ֔ם חָרְב֣וֹת יְקוֹמֵ֑מוּ רִֽאשֹׁנִ֖ים שֹׁמְמ֥וֹת וְחִדְּשׁוּ֙ חֹ֔רֶב עָ֣רֵי שֹׁמְמ֖וֹת דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nū ‘ō·w·lām ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ yə·qō·w·mê·mū ri·šō·nîm šō·mə·mō·wṯ wə·ḥid·də·šū ḥō·reḇ ‘ā·rê šō·mə·mō·wṯ dō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: They will rebuild the ancient ruins they will restore the places long devastated they will renew the ruined cities the desolations of many generations

verses.original: זָרִ֔ים וְעָמְד֣וּ וְרָע֖וּ צֹאנְכֶ֑ם וּבְנֵ֣י נֵכָ֔ר אִכָּרֵיכֶ֖ם וְכֹרְמֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zā·rîm wə·‘ā·mə·ḏū wə·rā·‘ū ṣō·nə·ḵem ū·ḇə·nê nê·ḵār ’ik·kā·rê·ḵem wə·ḵō·rə·mê·ḵem
verses.literal: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks and foreigners . . . will be your plowmen and vinedressers

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם תִּקָּרֵ֔אוּ כֹּהֲנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ יֵאָמֵ֖ר לָכֶ֑ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ חֵ֤יל גּוֹיִם֙ תִּתְיַמָּֽרוּ׃ וּבִכְבוֹדָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem tiq·qā·rê·’ū kō·hă·nê Yah·weh yê·’ā·mêr lā·ḵem mə·šā·rə·ṯê ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū tō·ḵê·lū ḥêl gō·w·yim tiṯ·yam·mā·rū ū·ḇiḵ·ḇō·w·ḏām
verses.literal: But you will be called the priests of the LORD they will speak of you as ministers of our God you will feed on the wealth of nations and you will boast in their riches

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת בָּשְׁתְּכֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה וּכְלִמָּ֖ה יָרֹ֣נּוּ חֶלְקָ֑ם לָכֵ֤ן יִירָ֔שׁוּ מִשְׁנֶ֣ה בְּאַרְצָם֙ עוֹלָ֖ם שִׂמְחַ֥ת תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ bā·šə·tə·ḵem miš·neh ū·ḵə·lim·māh yā·rōn·nū ḥel·qām lā·ḵên yî·rā·šū miš·neh bə·’ar·ṣām ‘ō·w·lām śim·ḥaṯ tih·yeh lā·hem
verses.literal: Instead of shame [My people will have a] double portion and [instead of] humiliation they will rejoice in their share and so they will inherit a double portion in their land and everlasting joy will be theirs

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֹהֵ֣ב מִשְׁפָּ֔ט שֹׂנֵ֥א גָזֵ֖ל בְּעוֹלָ֑ה בֶּאֱמֶ֔ת וְנָתַתִּ֤י פְעֻלָּתָם֙ אֶכְר֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם וּבְרִ֥ית לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ō·hêḇ miš·pāṭ śō·nê ḡā·zêl bə·‘ō·w·lāh be·’ĕ·meṯ wə·nā·ṯat·tî p̄ə·‘ul·lā·ṯām ’eḵ·rō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām ū·ḇə·rîṯ lā·hem
verses.literal: For I the LORD love justice I hate robbery and iniquity in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them

verses.original: זַרְעָ֔ם וְנוֹדַ֤ע בַּגּוֹיִם֙ וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעַמִּ֑ים כָּל־ רֹֽאֵיהֶם֙ יַכִּיר֔וּם כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע יְהוָֽה׃ס בֵּרַ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: zar·‘ām wə·nō·w·ḏa‘ bag·gō·w·yim wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’ê·hem bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘am·mîm kāl- rō·’ê·hem yak·kî·rūm kî hêm ze·ra‘ Yah·weh bê·raḵ
verses.literal: Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the peoples All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed

verses.original: שׂ֧וֹשׂ אָשִׂ֣ישׂ בַּֽיהוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁי֙ תָּגֵ֤ל בֵּֽאלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י הִלְבִּישַׁ֙נִי֙ בִּגְדֵי־ יֶ֔שַׁע יְעָטָ֑נִי מְעִ֥יל צְדָקָ֖ה כֶּֽחָתָן֙ יְכַהֵ֣ן פְּאֵ֔ר וְכַכַּלָּ֖ה תַּעְדֶּ֥ה כֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: śō·wś ’ā·śîś Yah·weh nap̄·šî tā·ḡêl bê·lō·hay kî hil·bî·ša·nî biḡ·ḏê- ye·ša‘ yə·‘ā·ṭā·nî mə·‘îl ṣə·ḏā·qāh ke·ḥā·ṯān yə·ḵa·hên pə·’êr wə·ḵak·kal·lāh ta‘·deh ḵê·le·hā
verses.literal: I will rejoice greatly . . . in the LORD my soul will exult in my God for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress as a bride adorns herself with her jewels

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תּוֹצִ֣יא צִמְחָ֔הּ וּכְגַנָּ֖ה זֵרוּעֶ֣יהָ תַצְמִ֑יחַ כֵּ֣ן׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה צְדָקָה֙ וּתְהִלָּ֔ה יַצְמִ֤יחַ נֶ֖גֶד כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵā·’ā·reṣ tō·w·ṣî ṣim·ḥāh ū·ḵə·ḡan·nāh zê·rū·‘e·hā ṯaṣ·mî·aḥ kên ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḏā·qāh ū·ṯə·hil·lāh yaṣ·mî·aḥ ne·ḡeḏ kāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: For as the earth brings forth its growth and as a garden enables seed to spring up so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations
